properties.summary: Tokenizer decision (DP4): run ONE calibration pass against the Anthropic count-tokens API with the owner's key injected per-process (never printed or exported), so the shipped table is a measured ratio plus a stated safety margin instead of the 1-token-per-UTF-8-byte proof that is ~4x loose; if the key is unavailable the proven bound ships and the report says budgets are conservative by ~4x
